alate: Alate head capsule nearly circular, the coronal suture and the fontanelle both indistinct, with several longitudinal striae arranged in three parallel lines in front of the fontanelle. Antennae 13–15-segmented (specimen broken). The long diameter of the compound eye about 3 times its distance to the lower margin of the head. The long diameter of the ocellus about 3 times the ocellus–compound eye distance, the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket about twice the distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Lacinia of the maxilla with 11 marginal bristles.
soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler, abdomen pale yellow.
